situation:
You are the human resources director at BRIARWOOD FITNESS CLUBS, a chain of nine clubs owned by the same family for three generations. The president (judge) has asked you to bring a recommendation to a meeting on Thursday, because either course the company takes will cost people their jobs.

BRIARWOOD FITNESS CLUBS sets its own membership price club by club, according to what each town will bear, and it has held members for years against a discount chain that charges half. What it sells against that price is its trainers, who are hired young and taught over two years by an in-house apprenticeship that eighteen employees run. Staff stay for that program, and members say they can tell.

SUMMIT WORKS WELLNESS NETWORK, a national corporate wellness network, has offered to place all nine clubs in its employer network. The network would bring steady monthly revenue from employers whose staff it enrolls. It also sets one membership price for every club in the network, and it requires its own class curriculum and its own trainer certification, which would replace the apprenticeship and end the eighteen positions that run it.

The president (judge) wants you to analyze the choice, recommend one course, and say how the layoff it requires should be selected and communicated. Joining the network means the chain can no longer set its own price club by club against the discount chain, and the eighteen apprenticeship positions end. Staying independent means the two clubs that have lost money for three years close and the forty people who work in them lose their jobs.

You will present your recommendation to the president (judge) in a meeting to take place in his/her office. The president (judge) will begin the meeting by greeting you and asking to hear your ideas. After you have presented and have answered the president's (judge) questions, the president (judge) will thank you for your work.
judgeCharacterization:
You are the president (judge) of BRIARWOOD FITNESS CLUBS, the third generation of your family to run it. Business background is the same as the situation above. The offer from SUMMIT WORKS WELLNESS NETWORK has to be answered this month, and both answers end jobs, so you want the recommendation and the plan for telling people together.

You want the human resources director to analyze the choice, recommend one course, and explain how the layoff would be selected and how it would be communicated.

During the presentation you are to ask the following questions of the participant:
judgeQuestions: Who ends up paying for this decision?
How would you explain that to the people it falls on?
